title: Swagger /docs on dev is not openly accessible and requires authentication
steps: GET https://simerp-dev-api.simform.solutions/docs with no credentials
GET https://simerp-dev-api.simform.solutions/docs/ with no credentials
expected: Docs are not served without auth; endpoint returns 401 with a WWW-Authenticate: Basic challenge (not 200 open HTML, not a default-credential login)
automationHint: Playwright request.get, assert status 401 and header www-authenticate=Basic
actualResult: /docs=401 (WWW-Authenticate: Basic), /docs/=401 (WWW-Authenticate: Basic). Swagger is mounted on dev but gated behind basic auth; no open docs page.

title: Swagger machine formats (/docs-json, /docs-yaml) also require authentication
steps: GET /docs-json and /docs-yaml with no credentials
GET common alternative doc paths (/api/docs, /swagger, /api-json)
expected: Machine-readable spec endpoints require auth (401); no alternative unauthenticated doc route exists
automationHint: Assert /docs-json and /docs-yaml return 401; alt paths 404
actualResult: /docs-json=401/Basic, /docs-yaml=401/Basic. /api/docs=404, /api/v1/docs=404, /swagger=404, /api-json=404. No open spec route.

title: Removed hardcoded swagger fallback credentials (admin/admin123) must not grant access
preconditions: Dev API reachable; /docs requires basic auth
steps: Confirm from code that app.config.ts no longer falls back to admin/admin123
Live confirmation of the specific credential pair was NOT attempted (out of scope: no auth brute force)
expected: Docs are protected by DevOps-configured credentials only; the old literal fallback is gone (app.config.ts swaggerUsername/Password default to '')
automationHint: Code-level: assert no 'admin123' literal in app.config.ts; live cred-guessing is out of scope
actualResult: /docs returns 401 Basic challenge, so credentials are required. The hardcoded fallback was removed in commit 7f44b6e5 (app.config.ts now defaults both to ''). Actively testing admin/admin123 against the live endpoint was intentionally skipped as auth guessing is out of scope.
notes: Blocked: verifying the specific removed credentials live would be auth guessing (prohibited). Code-confirmed removed.

title: API responses carry helmet security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff)
steps: GET /api/v1/health-check and inspect response headers
expected: Response includes Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and omits X-Powered-By
automationHint: Assert presence of helmet headers on any API response
actualResult: CSP=default-src 'self';...frame-ancestors 'self';object-src 'none';upgrade-insecure-requests; HSTS=max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; X-Frame-Options=SAMEORIGIN; X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff; COOP=same-origin; CORP=same-origin; Referrer-Policy=no-referrer; X-Powered-By absent.

title: API error responses do not leak stack traces or raw exception text
steps: Request a non-existent route, a bad UUID param, and a malformed login body
Inspect response bodies for stack frames / file paths / node_modules
expected: Errors return structured codes/messages only; no stack trace, file path, or exception text
automationHint: Assert body has no /.ts:\d+/ or 'at (...)' stack patterns
actualResult: 404 -> {code:SYS_002}, bad uuid -> {code:SYS_004, 'Validation failed (uuid is expected)'}, malformed login -> 404/validation. No stack traces, no file paths, no exception text in any response.

title: Employee/Zoho-sync log lines no longer carry names, emails or raw error text
steps: Trigger employee create/update/delete and Zoho sync
Inspect emitted log lines for emails/names/exception text
expected: Log messages use constant strings with identifiers (public UUID / employee number) in meta only; no PII in message text
automationHint: Not black-box testable without log access
actualResult: Not verifiable from outside: application logs go to CloudWatch and are not accessible in black-box scope. Code review of commit 7f44b6e5 confirms log sites in employees.service.ts and employees-metadata.service.ts were converted to constant messages + meta, with audit lines for CRUD. No external surface exposes these logs.
notes: Blocked: no log/DB access. Fix verified by code review only.

title: CORS rejects a foreign origin with no header reflection
steps: Send OPTIONS preflight and GET with Origin: https://evil.example.com
expected: Request is blocked (403); no Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflected, no credentials allowed
automationHint: Assert status 403 and absent ACAO for foreign origin
actualResult: Foreign origin: preflight=403, GET=403, ACAO=null, ACAC=null. No origin reflection.

title: CORS allows the configured frontend origin with credentials
steps: Send OPTIONS preflight and GET with Origin: https://simerp-dev.simform.solutions
expected: Allowed origin is reflected specifically (never '*') with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
automationHint: Assert ACAO equals the request origin and ACAC=true
actualResult: Allowed frontend: preflight=204, ACAO=https://simerp-dev.simform.solutions, ACAC=true. localhost:5173 also allowed (dev). No wildcard with credentials.

title: Deployed frontend bundle uses only an https API origin (no plaintext credentialed sink)
steps: Fetch index.html, enumerate JS bundles
Grep bundles for API/WS origins and any remote http:// references
expected: Only https:// (and wss://) origins; no remote http://host that would carry the cookie/JWT in plaintext
automationHint: Grep built JS for http:// non-loopback origins
actualResult: Only API origin in bundle is https://simerp-dev-api.simform.solutions. No remote http:// origins present. assertSecureTransport/buildEnvConfig would stop the app at startup on a plaintext remote origin; the app boots normally, consistent with an https config.

title: No secrets or API keys are embedded in the frontend JS bundle
steps: Scan all shipped JS bundles for AWS/GCP/Stripe/GitHub/Slack keys, private keys and JWTs
expected: No credential material in the client bundle; only public config (e.g. Sentry DSN) and VITE_ var names
automationHint: Grep bundles for known secret patterns; expect none
actualResult: No AWS/GCP/Stripe/GitHub/Slack keys, no hardcoded JWT or PRIVATE KEY blocks found across index + 6 vendor bundles (~1.2MB). Only VITE_ variable-name references appear.

title: App starts normally with a valid https origin config (secure-origin check does not false-block)
steps: Load the app and log in; confirm it reaches an authenticated page
expected: assertSecureTransport allows the configured https origin; app loads and authenticates without a startup throw
automationHint: Login flow succeeds end to end
actualResult: App loaded, login succeeded, landed on /employee. No startup error from the origin validation.

title: Frontend (CloudFront/S3) is missing security response headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
steps: GET the frontend root and inspect response headers
expected: Frontend should carry CSP, HSTS and X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors to prevent clickjacking and downgrade
automationHint: Assert frontend has X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors
actualResult: Frontend root (server: AmazonS3) returns NO security headers: CSP=null, HSTS=null, X-Frame-Options=null, X-Content-Type-Options=null. The app can be framed (clickjacking) and has no HSTS. This is a DevOps/CloudFront config gap explicitly flagged as 'NEEDS ACTION OUTSIDE THIS REPO' in the SI4-T1513 commit; not a code defect in Hardik's change.
notes: BUG-SEC-01 (DevOps-owned, acknowledged in T1513 commit body)

title: Non-privileged roles are denied admin-only endpoints (role-based access intact)
steps: As Employee, GET /roles and (as kriti) GET /projects
expected: Privileged endpoints return 403 for non-privileged roles
automationHint: Assert 403 AUTH_004 on /roles for Employee
actualResult: /roles -> 403 AUTH_004 for both accounts; kriti.desai /projects -> 403. Data-scoping holds: hardik (RM) sees 139 projects (his scope), kriti sees none.

title: Employee Details list screen and employees API still work
steps: Open /employee; confirm list renders
GET /employees?page=1&limit=100
expected: Employee list renders with data; employees API returns 200 with records
automationHint: Assert list rows > 0 and API 200
actualResult: UI shows 92 employees (v6.5.0). GET /employees -> 200, 92 records with full field set (team, department, designation, etc.). No errors after the logging/audit refactor.

title: Goals screen and goals API still work (goals.service.ts touched)
steps: Navigate Employee > Goals in the sidebar
GET /goals?page=1&limit=100
expected: Goals route resolves (no crash/404) and goals API returns 200 with data
automationHint: Assert /goals API 200 and items>0
actualResult: GET /goals?limit=100 -> 200 SUCCESS, 100 goal items. UI nav reaches /employee/goals (no 404). The redundant-cast removal in goals.service.ts caused no regression. (Top-level /goals is a graceful SPA 404 - not a route - not a defect.)

title: Zoho-analytics-driven employee metadata (team/department/designation) still populates

View list columns Department / RM / Projects
expected: team, department, designation, projects fields are present and populated after the employees-metadata.service refactor
automationHint: Assert employee objects carry team/department/designation
actualResult: Employees carry team, department, designation, projects, noticePeriod etc. UI list shows Department (PROJECT MANAGEMENT), RM (Hardik Trivedi), Projects, Log Hours correctly. Metadata pipeline unaffected.
